parameters.content:
## Marketing Command Center (Orchestrator)
1. **Marketing Director** (Gemini + Google Search) writes one campaign idea and briefs every agent.
2. Runs the sub-workflows in order: **Content -> SEO -> Paid Media -> Social Media**. SEO keywords feed Google Ads; the content agent's ad copy feeds the paid plan and its posts feed the social captions.
3. One approval page: edit captions, tick what to execute.
4. Executes through the same agents (posts go live, ad campaigns are created PAUSED) and gives you a downloadable report.

Configure the **Settings** nodes inside the Social Media Agent and the Paid Media Agent first. The SEO agent only runs when you give a website; the Paid agent only when you give a daily budget.
